Name: Deluxe Journal - Earthy Interface Recolor
Author: KickingBadger
Description:
[size=5]Description

[/size][size=3]I'm a big fan of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113692728]MolsonCAD's[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url] mod, and I've recently started using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url] mods as well. Unfortunately, the default color of the new tabs for Deluxe Journal didn't match and there wasn't a re-texture already made, so I decided to give it a go. I am by no means a skilled artist, simply an amateur who can use the eye-dropper tool, so if there is anything that looks weird, let me know!

This mod doesn't address anything else about Deluxe Journal as I don't understand the API well enough to do anything fancier. Enjoy!

Note: This is a recolor of MasonCAD's assets. I will take this mod down if requested.

[/size][size=5]Installation[/size][size=3][u]

Mod Manager:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Download using the mod manager button.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install/Enable the mod in your mod manager of choice.[/size]
[*][size=3]Make sure that this mod is loaded after Deluxe Journal.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u]Manual Installation:
[/u][/size][list]
[*][OPTIONAL] Make a copy of "ui.png" in "{Stardew Valley Installation}\mods\DeluxeJournal\assets\" and move it somewhere safe.
[*][size=3]Download the mod using the download button.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open the archive with winRAR, 7zip, etc.[/size]
[*][size=3]Copy the "DeluxeJournal" folder into your mods folder, making sure that it overwrites Deluxe Journal's files.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstalling[/size][size=3][u]

Mod Manager:[/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Uninstall/remove the mod in your mod manager.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u]Manual:
[/u][/size][list]
[*]If you saved a copy of ui.png, simply move it back to the assets folder, allowing it to overwrite this mod.
[*]Otherwise, you'll have to reinstall Deluxe Journal or grab the ui.png from its archive.
[/list]
